RWA.note: Mentions safeguards for privacy and academic integrity in the pilot only; no rule or authority on AI harms.
Civil servants are trained on Claude; no government body is stated to use AI in its own work or services.

facts.fact: ALX, Anthropic and the Government of Rwanda announce a Phase 2 pilot extending the Claude-based tutor Chidi to Rwanda's public education system, with up to 2,000 educators and higher learning institutions.

systems.tiers: pilot with educators and higher learning institutions

RWA.note: A working group will inform national AI policy in education; no strategy is stated drafted or adopted.
Chidi runs on a foreign model; localised African language models are only a future possibility.

facts.fact: A select group of Rwandan civil servants will take part in ALX's AI Career Essentials pilot, with the Minister of ICT saying it begins with capacity building for civil servants.

RWA.note: Training named is for educators and a few civil servants, not the public.
No school internet figure or compulsory curriculum stated.
Nothing on startup law or funding.
